questions.questionTextHi: क्रिकेट में, चित्र में दिख रहे व्यक्ति को _______ कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Wicket keeper**.

**Key Points**

	The **wicket-keeper** is a specialist **fielder** in the sport of **cricket** who stands behind the **stumps** at the striker's end of the pitch.
	Under the **Laws of Cricket**, specifically **Law 27**, the **wicket-keeper** is the only member of the fielding side permitted to wear **gloves** and external **leg guards** (pads).
	The primary responsibility of the **wicket-keeper** is to stop deliveries that pass the **batter** and to attempt to dismiss the **batter** through a **catch** or a **stumping**.
	A **stumping** occurs when the **wicket-keeper** puts down the **wicket** while the **batter** is out of their ground (crease) and not attempting a run.
	The **wicket-keeper** plays a crucial role in the fielding side's strategy, often acting as a "general" who provides feedback to the **bowler** and helps the captain with **field placements** due to their unique vantage point.

**Additional Information**

	**Batter**:

	
		A **batter** is the player currently at the **crease** whose objective is to score **runs** and prevent the ball from hitting the **stumps**.
		They use a **bat** made of **willow wood** and wear protective gear including a **helmet**, **gloves**, **pads**, and **arm guards**.
	
	
	**Bowler**:
	
		The **bowler** is the player who delivers the ball to the **batter**. The act of delivering the ball is called **bowling**.
		**Bowlers** are generally categorized into **fast bowlers** (who rely on speed) and **spin bowlers** (who use finger or wrist action to change the ball's trajectory).
	
	
	**Umpire**:
	
		The **umpire** is an official who has the authority to make decisions about events on the **cricket field** according to the **Laws of Cricket**.
		There are usually **two on-field umpires** and a **third umpire** (television umpire) who assists with close calls using technology like **ball-tracking** and **ultra-edge**.
	
	
	**Equipment and Rules**:
	
		The **wicket-keeper's gloves** must have **webbing** between the thumb and the index finger, but only to a specified **size** and **standard** regulated by the **Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC)**.
		Modern **wicket-keepers** almost always wear a **helmet** when standing close to the **stumps** for a **spinner** to protect against fast-moving balls or accidental hits from the **bat**.
		Famous **wicket-keepers** in the history of the game include **MS Dhoni** from **India**, **Adam Gilchrist** from **Australia**, and **Kumar Sangakkara** from **Sri Lanka**.
	
	

**Important Points**

	The **wicket-keeper** must remain wholly behind the **stumps** until the ball has been touched by the **batter** or has passed the **wicket**.
	If the **wicket-keeper** moves significantly before the ball is delivered, it can be called a **dead ball** or lead to penalties.
	In **Test cricket**, the **wicket-keeper** is often required to stay focused for up to **90 overs** a day, making it one of the most physically and mentally demanding positions in the sport.

सही उत्तर **विकेट रक्षक** है।

**Key Points** 

	**विकेट रक्षक** **क्रिकेट** के खेल में एक विशेषज्ञ **क्षेत्ररक्षक (फील्डर)** होता है जो पिच के बल्लेबाज वाले छोर पर विकेट के खंभे के पीछे खड़ा होता है।
	**क्रिकेट के नियमों**, विशेष रूप से **नियम 27** के तहत, विकेट रक्षक क्षेत्ररक्षण पक्ष का एकमात्र सदस्य है जिसे **दस्ताने (ग्लव्स)** और बाहरी **लेग गार्ड (पैड)** पहनने की अनुमति है।
	विकेट रक्षक की प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी **बल्लेबाज** के पास से गुजरने वाली गेंदों को रोकना और **रेखा **या विकेट के खंभे के माध्यम से **बल्लेबाज** को बाहर करने का प्रयास करना है।
	विकेट से बाहर तब होता है जब विकेट रक्षक **विकेट** गिरा देता है जबकि **बल्लेबाज** अपने रेखा (क्रीज) से बाहर होता है और रन लेने का प्रयास नहीं कर रहा होता है।
	विकेट रक्षक क्षेत्ररक्षण पक्ष की रणनीति में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, अक्सर एक "साधारण " के रूप में कार्य करता है जो **गेंदबाज** को प्रतिक्रिया प्रदान करता है और अपने अद्वितीय सुविधाजनक स्थान के कारण कप्तान को **क्षेत्ररक्षण (फील्ड) सजाने** में मदद करता है।

**Additional Information** 

	**बल्लेबाज (बैटर)**:

	
		एक **बल्लेबाज** वह खिलाड़ी होता है जो वर्तमान में **रेखा **पर होता है जिसका उद्देश्य **रन** बनाना और गेंद को  विकेट के खंभे पर लगने से रोकना होता है।
		वे **विलो लकड़ी** से बने **बल्ले** का उपयोग करते हैं और **हेलमेट**, **दस्ताने**,  पैर रक्षक और बाँह रक्षक सहित सुरक्षात्मक उपकरण पहनते हैं।
	
	
	**गेंदबाज (बॉलर)**:
	
		**गेंदबाज** वह खिलाड़ी होता है जो **बल्लेबाज** को गेंद फेंकता है। गेंद फेंकने की क्रिया को **गेंदबाजी** कहा जाता है।
		**गेंदबाजों** को आम तौर पर **तेज गेंदबाजों** (जो गति पर भरोसा करते हैं) और **घुमावदार गेंदबाजों** (जो गेंद के प्रक्षेपवक्र को बदलने के लिए उंगली या कलाई की क्रिया का उपयोग करते हैं) में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है।
	
	
	**निर्णायक **:
	
		**निर्णायक **एक अधिकारी होता है जिसके पास **क्रिकेट के नियमों** के अनुसार **क्रिकेट के मैदान** पर होने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में निर्णय लेने का अधिकार होता है।
		आमतौर पर दो मैदान पर मौजूद निर्णायक और एक तीसरा निर्णायक (दूरदर्शन निर्णायक) होता है, जो गेंद-पथ निगरानी और अति-किनारा जैसी तकनीकों का उपयोग करके करीबी निर्णयों में सहायता करता है।
	
	
	**उपकरण और नियम**:
	
		विकेट रक्षक **के दस्तानों** में अंगूठे और तर्जनी के बीच **वेबिंग** होनी चाहिए, लेकिन केवल **मैरीलेबोन क्रिकेट क्लब (MCC)** द्वारा विनियमित एक निर्दिष्ट **आकार** और **मानक** तक।
		आधुनिक विकेट रक्षक तेज गति वाली गेंदों या **बल्ले** से आकस्मिक प्रहार से बचने के लिए स्पिन गेंदबाजों के लिए विकेट के खंभों के करीब खड़े होने पर लगभग हमेशा सिर सुरक्षा आवरण पहनते हैं।
		खेल के इतिहास में प्रसिद्ध विकेट रक्षको में **भारत** के **एमएस धोनी**, **ऑस्ट्रेलिया** के **एडम गिलक्रिस्ट** और **श्रीलंका** के **कुमार संगकारा** शामिल हैं।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	विकेट रक्षक को तब तक पूरी तरह से **विकेट के खंभे** के पीछे रहना चाहिए जब तक कि गेंद को **बल्लेबाज** द्वारा छुआ न गया हो या वह **विकेट** के पास से न गुजर गई हो।
	यदि विकेट रक्षक गेंद फेंके जाने से पहले महत्वपूर्ण रूप से हिलता है, तो इसे **निष्क्रिय गेंद** कहा जा सकता है या इसके परिणामस्वरूप दंड दिया जा सकता है।
	**परीक्षण क्रिकेट** में, विकेट रक्षक को अक्सर एक दिन में **90 ओवरों** तक ध्यान केंद्रित रखने की आवश्यकता होती है, जिससे यह खेल में सबसे शारीरिक और मानसिक रूप से कठिन पदों में से एक बन जाता है।

questions.questionTextHi: नीचे दी गई छवि  निम्नलिखित में से किस खेल से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Basketball**.

**Key Points**

	**Basketball** is a team sport characterized by two teams, typically consisting of **five players** each, competing on a **rectangular court**.
	The primary objective of the game is to shoot a **ball** through a raised hoop, known as the **basket** or **rim**, which is mounted at a height of **10 feet** (**3.048 meters**) to a **backboard** at each end of the court.
	The sport was invented in **December 1891** by **Dr. James Naismith**, a Canadian physical education instructor, in **Springfield, Massachusetts**, as a way to keep his students active indoors during the winter.
	The international governing body for the sport is **FIBA** (**International Basketball Federation**), which was founded in **1932**.
	A standard professional basketball court measures **28 by 15 meters** under **FIBA** rules and **94 by 50 feet** in the **NBA** (**National Basketball Association**).

**Additional Information**

	**Common Terminologies:**

	
		**Dribbling**: The act of bouncing the ball continuously with one hand while walking or running.
		**Rebound**: Gaining possession of the ball after a missed **field goal** or **free throw**.
		**Layup**: A **two-point** shot attempt made by leaping from below, laying the ball up near the basket, and using one hand to bounce it off the backboard and into the basket.
		**Three-pointer**: A field goal made from beyond the **three-point line**, a designated arc surrounding the basket.
	
	
	**Gameplay Duration:**
	
		In the **NBA**, a game consists of **four quarters** of **12 minutes** each.
		Under **FIBA** regulations, the game consists of **four quarters** of **10 minutes** each.
	
	
	**Major Organizations:**
	
		The **NBA**, based in **North America**, is widely considered the premier professional basketball league in the world in terms of popularity, salaries, and level of competition.
		**Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA)** is the equivalent professional league for women in the **United States**.
	
	

**Important Points**

	**Player Positions:**

	
		**Point Guard (PG)**: Usually the team's best ball handler and passer, responsible for directing the offense.
		**Shooting Guard (SG)**: Typically the team's best outside shooter.
		**Small Forward (SF)**: Often a versatile player responsible for scoring and rebounding.
		**Power Forward (PF)**: Plays offensively with their back to the basket and focuses on defense and rebounding.
		**Center (C)**: Usually the tallest player, positioned near the basket to block shots and secure rebounds.
	
	
	**Violations and Fouls:**
	
		**Traveling**: Taking more than two steps without dribbling the ball.
		**Double Dribble**: Dribbling the ball with two hands at the same time or stopping the dribble and then starting again.
		**Personal Foul**: Illegal physical contact with an opponent.
	
	
	**Olympic History:** Basketball became an official **Olympic sport** for men at the **1936 Berlin Games** and for women at the **1976 Montreal Games**.
questions.explanationHi:
सही उत्तर **बास्केटबॉल** है।

**Key Points** 

	**बास्केटबॉल** एक दलीय खेल है जिसमें दो दल होती हैं, जिनमें आमतौर पर **पांच खिलाड़ी** होते हैं, जो एक **आयताकार क्षेत्र **पर प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।
	खेल का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य एक **गेंद** को एक ऊंचे घेरे के माध्यम से डालना है, जिसे **बास्केट** या **रिम** के रूप में जाना जाता है, जो कोर्ट के प्रत्येक छोर पर एक **पृष्ठपट **पर **10 फीट** (**3.048 मीटर**) की ऊंचाई पर लगा होता है।
	इस खेल का आविष्कार **दिसंबर 1891** में **डॉ. जेम्स नाइस्मिथ** द्वारा किया गया था, जो **स्प्रिंगफील्ड, मैसाचुसेट्स** में एक कनाडाई शारीरिक शिक्षा प्रशिक्षक थे, ताकि सर्दियों के दौरान उनके छात्र घर के अंदर सक्रिय रह सकें।
	खेल के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय शासी निकाय **FIBA** (**इंटरनेशनल बास्केटबॉल फेडरेशन**) है, जिसकी स्थापना **1932** में हुई थी।
	एक मानक पेशेवर बास्केटबॉल क्षेत्र **FIBA** नियमों के तहत **28 गुणा 15 मीटर** और **NBA** (**नेशनल बास्केटबॉल एसोसिएशन**) में **94 गुणा 50 फीट** का होता है।

**Additional Information** 

	**सामान्य शब्दावली:**

	
		**ड्रिब्लिंग (Dribbling)**: चलते या दौड़ते समय एक हाथ से गेंद को लगातार उछालने की क्रिया।
		**रिबाउंड (Rebound)**: छूटे हुए **फील्ड गोल** या **फ्री थ्रो** के बाद गेंद पर कब्जा करना।
		**लेअप (Layup)**: नीचे से छलांग लगाकर किया गया **दो-अंक** वाला प्रहार प्रयास, जिसमें गेंद को बास्केट के पास ऊपर रखा जाता है और एक हाथ का उपयोग करके इसे पृष्ठपट से टकराकर बास्केट में डाला जाता है।
		तीन-अंकीय प्रहार (थ्री-पॉइंटर): तीन-अंक रेखा के बाहर से किया गया एक क्षेत्रीय गोल, जो टोकरी के चारों ओर बनी एक निश्चित चाप रेखा होती है।
	
	
	**खेल की अवधि:**
	
		**NBA** में, एक खेल में **12 मिनट** के **चार क्वार्टर** होते हैं।
		**FIBA** नियमों के तहत, खेल में **10 मिनट** के **चार क्वार्टर** होते हैं।
	
	
	**प्रमुख संगठन:**
	
		**उत्तरी अमेरिका** में स्थित **NBA** को लोकप्रियता, वेतन और प्रतिस्पर्धा के स्तर के मामले में दुनिया की प्रमुख पेशेवर बास्केटबॉल लीग माना जाता है।
		**महिला राष्ट्रीय बास्केटबॉल संघ**** (WNBA)** **संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका** में महिलाओं के लिए समकक्ष पेशेवर लीग है।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**खिलाड़ियों की स्थिति:**

	
		**अंक रक्षक (पॉइंट गार्ड):** आमतौर पर दल का सबसे अच्छा गेंद नियंत्रक और पास देने वाला खिलाड़ी होता है, जो आक्रमण का संचालन करने के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है।
		**प्रहार रक्षक (शूटिंग गार्ड): आमतौर पर दल का सबसे अच्छा बाहरी प्रहार करने वाला खिलाड़ी**।
		**छोटा अग्रणी (स्मॉल फॉरवर्ड):** अक्सर एक बहुमुखी खिलाड़ी होता है, जो अंक बनाने और गेंद को पुनः प्राप्त करने (रिबाउंडिंग) के लिए जिम्मेदार होता है।
		**शक्ति अग्रणी (पावर फॉरवर्ड): **टोकरी की ओर पीठ करके आक्रामक रूप से खेलता है और रक्षा तथा गेंद को पुनः प्राप्त करने (रिबाउंडिंग) पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।
		**केंद्र **(सेंटर): आमतौर पर सबसे लंबा खिलाड़ी होता है, जो प्रहार रोकने और गेंद को पुनः प्राप्त करने (रिबाउंड सुरक्षित करने) के लिए टोकरी के पास स्थित होता है।
	
	
	**उल्लंघन और ** **गलत खेल****:**
	
		**यात्रा दोष (ट्रैवलिंग):** गेंद को ड्रिबल (गेंद को उछालते हुए आगे बढ़ना) किए बिना दो से अधिक कदम चलना।
		दोहरा ड्रिबल (डबल ड्रिबल): एक ही समय में दोनों हाथों से गेंद को उछालना या ड्रिबल रोकने के बाद दोबारा ड्रिबल शुरू करना।
		**पर्सनल फाउल (Personal Foul)**: प्रतिद्वंद्वी के साथ अवैध शारीरिक संपर्क।
	
	
	**ओलंपिक इतिहास:** बास्केटबॉल **1936 के बर्लिन खेलों** में पुरुषों के लिए और **1976 के मॉन्ट्रियल खेलों** में महिलाओं के लिए एक आधिकारिक **ओलंपिक खेल** बना।

questions.questionText: The Red-Fort construction was begun in 1639 and completed after ____ years.
questions.questionTextHi: लाल किले का निर्माण 1639 में शुरू हुआ था और _____ वर्षों के बाद पूरा हुआ था।
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **9**.

**Key Points**

	The construction of the **Red Fort** (Lal Qila) was commissioned by the **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan** on **13 May 1638**, when he decided to shift his capital from **Agra** to **Delhi**.
	While the site preparation began earlier, the actual construction process is widely cited to have started in **1639**.
	The massive fort project was completed in **1648**, which means the construction spanned a period of **9 years**.
	The fort was designed by the architect **Ustad Ahmad Lahori**, the same genius who designed the **Taj Mahal** in **Agra**.
	The fort served as the main residence of the **Mughal Emperors** for nearly **200 years**, until the end of the **Mughal dynasty** in **1857**.
	It is located in **Old Delhi** (then known as **Shahjahanabad**) and is situated along the banks of the **Yamuna River**.

**Additional Information**

	**Architectural Style**: The Red Fort represents the zenith of **Mughal architecture**, characterized by a fusion of **Persian**, **Timurid**, and **Indian** styles. It is built primarily of **Red Sandstone**, which gives it its name.
	**UNESCO Recognition**: In the year **2007**, the Red Fort was designated as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** due to its historical and cultural significance.
	**Main Structures**:
	
		**Diwan-i-Aam**: The hall of public audience.
		**Diwan-i-Khas**: The hall of private audience, which once housed the famous **Peacock Throne** (Takht-i-Taus).
		**Rang Mahal**: Known as the "Palace of Colours," it was the residence of the emperor's wives.
		**Moti Masjid**: The Pearl Mosque, added later by Emperor **Aurangzeb** between **1659 and 1660**.
	
	
	**Symbol of Sovereignty**: Since India's independence on **15 August 1947**, the fort has been a symbol of national pride. Every year, the **Prime Minister of India** hoists the **National Flag** from its ramparts.

**Important Points**

	**Historical Shifts**: The fort saw several invasions, most notably by **Nadir Shah** in **1739**, who plundered the palace and took the **Peacock Throne** and the **Koh-i-Noor diamond**.
	**British Era**: After the **Revolt of 1857**, the British army occupied the fort, demolished many of its residential palaces, and converted it into a **military garrison**.
	**The Gates**: The fort has two main ceremonial gates: the **Lahori Gate** (the main entrance) and the **Delhi Gate**.
	**Geographical Context**: The fort covers an area of approximately **254 acres** and is enclosed by **2.4 kilometres** of defensive walls.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a Sushir Vadya?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सुषिर वाद्य है?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Bargu**.

**Key Points**

	**Sushir Vadya**, also known as **Aerophones**, are musical instruments where sound is produced by the vibration of air, typically blown through a tube or a reed.
	**Bargu** is a traditional wind instrument primarily found in the state of **Rajasthan**, India. It is a long, curved trumpet or horn made of **brass** or **copper**.
	This instrument is widely associated with the **Bhil tribe** of **Rajasthan** and **Madhya Pradesh**. It is commonly played during community gatherings, **festivals**, and traditional ceremonies like **weddings**.
	The **Bargu** is frequently used to accompany the **Gair dance**, a famous tribal dance of the **Bhils**, providing a deep, resonant sound that signals the beginning of performances or religious processions.
	Historically, such horns were also used as signaling devices to warn villagers of approaching **threats** or to announce the arrival of important **dignitaries**.

**Additional Information**

	**Classification of Musical Instruments:**

	
		In the ancient text **Natya Shastra**, written by **Bharat Muni** between **200 BC and 200 AD**, Indian musical instruments are classified into **four** main categories.
		**Tata Vadya (Chordophones):** These are stringed instruments. Examples include the **Veena**, **Sitar**, **Sarangi**, and the **Pena** (a traditional bowed instrument of **Manipur**).
		**Sushir Vadya (Aerophones):** These are wind instruments. Examples include the **Bansuri** (flute), **Shehnai**, **Shankh** (conch), **Pungi**, and **Bargu**.
		**Avanaddha Vadya (Membranophones):** These are percussion instruments with a stretched skin or membrane. Examples include the **Tabla**, **Dholak**, **Mridangam**, and **Nagada**.
		**Ghana Vadya (Idiophones):** These are solid instruments made of metal or wood that do not require tuning. Examples include **Manjira**, **Jhanj**, **Karthal**, and **Hath ghanti** (hand bell).
	
	
	**Regional Wind Instruments:**
	
		**Mashak:** A type of **bagpipe** found in **Rajasthan** and **Uttarakhand**, often made from **goat skin**.
		**Algoza:** A double flute popular in **Punjab** and **Rajasthan** folk music, played simultaneously by the musician.
		**Karna:** A straight, long **brass** trumpet used in temple processions and royal announcements in **North India**.
	
	

**Important Points**

	The **Pena** is a **Tata Vadya** (string instrument) and is the oldest musical instrument of the **Meitei** people of **Manipur**. ***Hence, option 2 is incorrect.***
	**Hath ghanti** belongs to the **Ghana Vadya** category as it is a solid metal instrument that produces sound through the vibration of its own body. ***Hence, option 1 is incorrect.***
	The **Bargu** is specifically characterized as a **Sushir Vadya** because it requires the **player's breath** to resonate air within its metal body to produce sound. ***Hence, the correct answer is Bargu.***
	**Sushir Vadya** are often classified into two types: those where the air is blown through a **natural hole** (like a flute) and those using a **mechanical reed** (like the **Shehnai**).

सही उत्तर **बरगु** है।

**Key Points** 

	**सुषिर वाद्य, **जिन्हें** वायु-वाद्य** भी कहा जाता है, वे वाद्य यंत्र हैं जिनमें ध्वनि हवा के कंपन से उत्पन्न होती है। यह ध्वनि सामान्यतः किसी नली या कंपन-पट्टी के माध्यम से फूँक मारकर पैदा की जाती है।
	**बरगु** एक पारंपरिक पवन वाद्य यंत्र है जो मुख्य रूप से भारत के **राजस्थान** राज्य में पाया जाता है। यह **पीतल** या **तांबे** से बना एक लंबा, घुमावदार तुरही या हॉर्न है।
	यह वाद्य यंत्र व्यापक रूप से **राजस्थान** और **मध्य प्रदेश** की **भील जनजाति** से जुड़ा हुआ है। इसे आमतौर पर सामुदायिक समारोहों, **त्योहारों** और **शादियों** जैसे पारंपरिक समारोहों के दौरान बजाया जाता है।
	**बरगु** का उपयोग अक्सर **भीलों** के प्रसिद्ध जनजातीय नृत्य, **गैर नृत्य** के साथ किया जाता है, जो एक गहरी, गूंजने वाली ध्वनि प्रदान करता है जो प्रदर्शन या धार्मिक जुलूसों की शुरुआत का संकेत देता है।
	ऐतिहासिक रूप से, ऐसे भोंपू  का उपयोग ग्रामीणों को आने वाले **खतरों** के प्रति सचेत करने या महत्वपूर्ण **गणमान्य व्यक्तियों** के आगमन की घोषणा करने के लिए सिग्नलिंग उपकरणों के रूप में भी किया जाता था।

**Additional Information** 

	**वाद्य यंत्रों का वर्गीकरण:**

	
		**भरत मुनि** द्वारा **200 ईसा पूर्व और 200 ईस्वी** के बीच लिखे गए प्राचीन ग्रंथ **नाट्य शास्त्र** में, भारतीय वाद्य यंत्रों को **चार** मुख्य श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
		**तत वाद्य (कॉर्डोफोन्स):** ये तार वाले वाद्य यंत्र हैं। उदाहरणों में **वीणा**, **सितार**, **सारंगी** और **पेना** (**मणिपुर** का एक पारंपरिक तार वाला वाद्य यंत्र) शामिल हैं।
		**सुषिर वाद्य (एयरोफोन्स):** ये पवन वाद्य यंत्र हैं। उदाहरणों में **बांसुरी**, **शहनाई**, **शंख**, **पुंगी** और **बरगु** शामिल हैं।
		**अवनद्ध वाद्य (मेम्ब्रेनोफोन्स):** ये खींची हुई खाल या झिल्ली वाले ताल वाद्य यंत्र हैं। उदाहरणों में **तबला**, **ढोलक**, **मृदंगम** और **नगाड़ा** शामिल हैं।
		**घन वाद्य (इडियोफोन्स):** ये धातु या लकड़ी से बने ठोस वाद्य यंत्र हैं जिन्हें धुन की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। उदाहरणों में **मंजीरा**, **झांझ**, **करताल** और **हाथ घंटी** शामिल हैं।
	
	
	**क्षेत्रीय पवन वाद्य यंत्र:**
	
		**मशक:** **राजस्थान** और **उत्तराखंड** में पाया जाने वाला एक प्रकार का **बैगपाइप**, जो अक्सर **बकरी की खाल** से बना होता है।
		**अल्गोजा:** **पंजाब** और **राजस्थान** के लोक संगीत में लोकप्रिय एक दोहरी बांसुरी, जिसे संगीतकार द्वारा एक साथ बजाया जाता है।
		**कर्णा:** **उत्तर भारत** में मंदिर के जुलूसों और शाही घोषणाओं में इस्तेमाल होने वाली एक सीधी, लंबी **पीतल** की तुरही।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**पेना** एक **तत वाद्य** (तार वाला यंत्र) है और **मणिपुर** के **मैतेई** लोगों का सबसे पुराना वाद्य यंत्र है। ***इसलिए, विकल्प 2 गलत है।***
	**हाथ घंटी** **घन वाद्य** श्रेणी से संबंधित है क्योंकि यह एक ठोस धातु का यंत्र है जो अपने स्वयं के शरीर के कंपन के माध्यम से ध्वनि उत्पन्न करता है। ***इसलिए, विकल्प 1 गलत है।***
	**बरगु** को विशेष रूप से **सुषिर वाद्य** के रूप में जाना जाता है क्योंकि इसमें ध्वनि उत्पन्न करने के लिए इसके धातु के शरीर के भीतर हवा को गुंजाने के लिए **वादक की सांस** की आवश्यकता होती है। ***इसलिए, सही उत्तर बरगु है।***
	**सुषिर वाद्य** को अक्सर दो प्रकारों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है: वे जहाँ हवा को एक **प्राकृतिक छेद** (जैसे बांसुरी) के माध्यम से फूँका जाता है और वे जो **मैकेनिकल रीड** (जैसे **शहनाई**) का उपयोग करते हैं।

questions.questionText: Whom did Mahatma Gandhi regard as his mentor?
questions.questionTextHi: महात्मा गांधी किसे अपना गुरु मानते थे?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**.

**Key Points**

	**Gopal Krishna Gokhale** was a senior leader of the **Indian National Congress** and a renowned social reformer who **Mahatma Gandhi** regarded as his **political mentor**.
	After **Mahatma Gandhi** returned to **India** from **South Africa** in **January 1915**, he sought guidance from **Gokhale**, who advised him to travel across the **Indian subcontinent** for **one year** to understand the ground realities of the people before taking any political stance.
	**Gandhi** expressed his deep respect and intellectual debt to **Gokhale** in his book titled **"Gokhale, My Political Guru"**, published in **1955**.
	**Gokhale** was a leading figure of the **Moderate** faction of the **Congress**, advocating for **constitutional means**, **dialogue**, and **reforms** rather than radical or violent methods to achieve **Swaraj**.
	In **1905**, **Gopal Krishna Gokhale** founded the **Servants of India Society** in **Pune**, **Maharashtra**, with the aim of training Indians to devote their lives to the cause of the nation through social and humanitarian work.
	He also served as the **President** of the **Banaras Session** of the **Indian National Congress** in **1905**.

**Additional Information**

	**Lala Lajpat Rai:**

	
		Known as **"Punjab Kesari"** (the Lion of Punjab), he was a prominent leader of the **Extremist** wing of the **Congress** (part of the **Lal-Bal-Pal** trio).
		He played a crucial role in the **Swadeshi Movement** and founded the **Punjab National Bank** in **1894**.
		He died in **1928** after sustaining injuries during a **lathi charge** while protesting against the **Simon Commission**.
	
	
	**Dadabhai Naoroji:**
	
		Known as the **"Grand Old Man of India"**, he was a co-founder of the **Indian National Congress** and served as its **President** three times (**1886, 1893, and 1906**).
		He was the first **Indian** to be elected as a **Member of Parliament (MP)** in the **British House of Commons**.
		He authored the famous book **"Poverty and Un-British Rule in India"**, which introduced the **"Drain of Wealth"** theory, explaining how **Britain** was depleting **India's** resources.
	
	
	**Subhash Chandra Bose:**
	
		A radical nationalist leader who twice served as the **President** of the **Congress** (**1938 and 1939**) before resigning due to ideological differences with **Gandhi**.
		He founded the **All India Forward Bloc** in **1939** and later led the **Indian National Army (INA)** or **Azad Hind Fauj** to fight against **British** rule.
		Interestingly, despite their differences, it was **Bose** who first addressed **Mahatma Gandhi** as the **"Father of the Nation"** in a radio address from **Singapore** in **1944**.
	
	

**Important Points**

	**Political Ideology:** **Gokhale** believed in **secularism** and **education** as the primary tools for national awakening. He was a member of the **Imperial Legislative Council** from **1902** until his death in **1915**.
	**Role in Reforms:** He was instrumental in the formulation of the **Morley-Minto Reforms** of **1909**, which increased **Indian** participation in the legislative process, although it also introduced **separate electorates**.
	**Mentorship:** Besides **Gandhi**, **Gokhale** also influenced several other leaders, including **Mohammed Ali Jinnah** in his early years, who aspired to become the **"Muslim Gokhale"** due to his ambassadorial role for **Hindu-Muslim unity**.
	**Journalism:** **Gokhale** was associated with the journal **"Sudharak"** (The Reformer) and contributed significantly to the **Sarvajanik Sabha** journal.

सही उत्तर **गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले** है।

**Key Points** 

	**गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले** **भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस** के एक वरिष्ठ नेता और एक प्रसिद्ध समाज सुधारक थे, जिन्हें **महात्मा गांधी** अपना **राजनीतिक गुरु** मानते थे।
	**जनवरी 1915** में **दक्षिण अफ्रीका** से **भारत** लौटने के बाद, **महात्मा गांधी** ने **गोखले** से मार्गदर्शन मांगा, जिन्होंने उन्हें किसी भी राजनीतिक रुख को अपनाने से पहले लोगों की जमीनी हकीकत को समझने के लिए **एक वर्ष** तक **भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप** की यात्रा करने की सलाह दी।
	**गांधी** ने **1955** में प्रकाशित अपनी पुस्तक **"गोखले, माई राजनीतिक गुरु"** में गोखले के प्रति अपना गहरा सम्मान और बौद्धिक ऋण व्यक्त किया।
	**गोखले** **कांग्रेस** के **नरमपंथी** गुट के एक प्रमुख नेता थे, जो **स्वराज** प्राप्त करने के लिए कट्टरपंथी या हिंसक तरीकों के बजाय **संवैधानिक साधनों**, **संवाद** और **सुधारों** की वकालत करते थे।
	**1905** में, **गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले** ने सामाजिक और मानवीय कार्यों के माध्यम से भारतीयों को राष्ट्र के हित के लिए अपना जीवन समर्पित करने के लिए प्रशिक्षित करने के उद्देश्य से **पुणे**, **महाराष्ट्र** में भारत सेवक समाज की स्थापना  की।
	उन्होंने **1905** में **भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस** के **बनारस अधिवेशन** के **अध्यक्ष** के रूप में भी कार्य किया।

**Additional Information** 

	**लाला लाजपत राय:**

	
		**"पंजाब केसरी"** (पंजाब का शेर) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले, वह **कांग्रेस** के **गरमपंथी** विंग के एक प्रमुख नेता थे (**लाल-बाल-पाल** तिकड़ी का हिस्सा)।
		उन्होंने **स्वदेशी आंदोलन** में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई और **1894** में **पंजाब नेशनल बैंक** की स्थापना की।
		**साइमन कमीशन** के विरोध के दौरान **लाठीचार्ज** में घायल होने के बाद **1928** में उनकी मृत्यु हो गई।
	
	
	**दादाभाई नौरोजी:**
	
		**"** **भारत के वयोवृद्ध पुरुष****"** के रूप में जाने जाने वाले, वह **भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस** के सह-संस्थापक थे और तीन बार (**1886, 1893 और 1906**) इसके **अध्यक्ष** के रूप में कार्य किया।
		वह ब्रिटेन की लोक सभा में **संसद सदस्य (MP)** के रूप में चुने जाने वाले पहले **भारतीय** थे।
		उन्होंने प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक **"भारत में गरीबी और ब्रिटिश शासन की अन्यायपूर्ण व्यवस्था****"** लिखी, जिसमें **"धन के निष्कासन" (Drain of Wealth)** का सिद्धांत पेश किया गया, जिसमें बताया गया कि कैसे **ब्रिटेन** **भारत** के संसाधनों को खत्म कर रहा था।
	
	
	**सुभाष चंद्र बोस:**
	
		एक कट्टरपंथी राष्ट्रवादी नेता जिन्होंने **गांधी** के साथ वैचारिक मतभेदों के कारण इस्तीफा देने से पहले दो बार **कांग्रेस** के **अध्यक्ष** (**1938 और 1939**) के रूप में कार्य किया।
		उन्होंने **1939** में **अखिल भारतीय अग्रगामी दल** की स्थापना की और बाद में **ब्रिटिश** शासन के खिलाफ लड़ने के लिए **भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सेना (INA)** या **आजाद हिंद फौज** का नेतृत्व किया।
		दिलचस्प बात यह है कि उनके मतभेदों के बावजूद, **बोस** ही थे जिन्होंने पहली बार **1944** में **सिंगापुर** से एक रेडियो संबोधन में **महात्मा गांधी** को **"राष्ट्रपिता"** के रूप में संबोधित किया था।
	
	

**Important Points** 

	**राजनीतिक विचारधारा:** **गोखले** राष्ट्रीय जागरण के प्राथमिक साधनों के रूप में **धर्मनिरपेक्षता** और **शिक्षा** में विश्वास करते थे। वह **1902** से **1915** में अपनी मृत्यु तक** साम्राज्यीय विधान परिषद​ **के सदस्य रहे।
	**सुधारों में भूमिका:** उन्होंने **1909** के **मार्ले-मिंटो सुधारों** के निर्माण में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी, जिसने विधायी प्रक्रिया में **भारतीय** भागीदारी को बढ़ाया, हालांकि इसने **पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल** की भी शुरुआत की।
	**परामर्शदाता (मेंटरशिप):** **गांधी** के अलावा, **गोखले** ने अपने शुरुआती वर्षों में **मोहम्मद अली जिन्ना** सहित कई अन्य नेताओं को भी प्रभावित किया, जो **हिंदू-मुस्लिम एकता** के लिए उनकी राजदूत भूमिका के कारण **"मुस्लिम गोखले"** बनने की आकांक्षा रखते थे।
	**पत्रकारिता:** **गोखले** पत्रिका **"सुधारक"** से जुड़े थे और उन्होंने **सार्वजनिक सभा** पत्रिका में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following idiom given in the alternatives has the meaning?
An offer made without conditions or restrictions, and requires nothing in return.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. With no strings attached**.

**Key Points**

    The idiom **"With no strings attached"** means an offer made without conditions, restrictions, or requiring anything in return. (बिना किसी शर्त के)
    
        **Example:** The company offered a free trial of its software with no strings attached.
    
    This idiom is often used in situations where something is given freely and the giver does not expect anything in return. (यह तब उपयोग किया जाता है जब कुछ बिना अपेक्षा के दिया जाता है।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. With no strings attached**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

    **Keep one on a string** (किसी को अपने वश में रखना): To control or manipulate someone as if pulling their strings.
    
        **Example:** He kept her on a string, never committing to the relationship but not letting her go either.
    
    

    **Loosen the apron strings** (स्वतंत्र होने देना): To allow someone (often a child) to become independent.
    
        **Example:** It's time for her parents to loosen the apron strings and let her make her own decisions.
    
    

    **Loosen the purse strings** (खर्च करने के लिए तैयार होना): To be willing to spend money or increase expenditure.
    
        **Example:** The government decided to loosen the purse strings to fund new infrastructure projects.

questions.questionText:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.
The penny drops.

options.text: Said when someone suddenly comes to realize or understand something
Said when someone suddenly comes to feel angry about something
Said when someone suddenly comes to bends to pick something
Said when someone suddenly comes to feel loved by somebody

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. "Said when someone suddenly comes to realize or understand something"**.

**Key Points**

    The phrase **"The penny drops"** means the moment when someone suddenly realizes or understands something clearly. (जब किसी को अचानक कुछ स्पष्ट रूप से समझ में आता है।)
    
    
        **Example:** It took me a while to understand the joke, but then the penny dropped, and I burst out laughing.
    
    
    This idiom is commonly used in situations where the realization comes after a delay or hesitation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. "Said when someone suddenly comes to realize or understand something"**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

    **Option 2:** **Said when someone suddenly comes to feel angry about something** (जब किसी को अचानक गुस्सा महसूस होता है।)
    
        **Example:** This option is incorrect because "The penny drops" does not relate to feelings of anger.
    
    
    **Option 3:** **Said when someone suddenly bends to pick something** (जब कोई अचानक कुछ उठाने के लिए झुकता है।)
    
        **Example:** This option is incorrect as "The penny drops" is not related to physical actions like bending down.
    
    
    **Option 4:** **Said when someone suddenly comes to feel loved by somebody** (जब कोई अचानक किसी द्वारा प्यार महसूस करता है।)
    
        **Example:** This option is incorrect as the idiom does not refer to feelings of love or affection.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to **“damaged”**.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Flawless**.

**Key Points**

    The word **"damaged"** refers to something that has been harmed or impaired, reducing its value or usefulness. (क्षतिग्रस्त)

    
        **Example:** The car was damaged in the accident and needed extensive repairs.
    

    **"Flawless"** means something that is perfect, without any imperfections, defects, or damage. (बिना दोष के)

    
        **Example:** Her performance in the competition was flawless, earning her a perfect score.
    

    Hence, the word **'Flawless'** is the most appropriate opposite of **'damaged'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flawless**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

    **Deteriorated** (बिगड़ गया): Something that has become progressively worse in condition or quality.

    
        **Example:** The condition of the old house has deteriorated over the years due to neglect.
    
    

    **Defaced** (बिगाड़ना): To spoil the appearance or surface of something, often deliberately.

    
        **Example:** The monument was defaced with graffiti by vandals.
    
    

    **Broken** (टूटा हुआ): Reduced to pieces or in a state that is no longer functional.

    
        **Example:** The broken vase lay scattered on the floor after it fell from the table.

questions.questionText: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Habitual**.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **2) Occasional**.

**Key Points**

    The word **"Habitual"** refers to something done as a habit or regularly, often without thinking. (आदतन)
    
        **Example:** He is a habitual latecomer, always arriving after the meeting starts.
    
    The word **"Occasional"** is the correct antonym for "Habitual." It means happening or occurring infrequently or irregularly. (कभी-कभार)
    
        **Example:** She is an occasional visitor to the library, dropping by only once or twice a month.
    
    Hence, the opposite of **"Habitual"** is **"Occasional."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2) Occasional**.

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

    **Regular** (नियमित): Done or happening frequently or consistently.
    
        **Example:** He is a regular customer of this coffee shop, visiting every morning.
    

    **Customary** (परंपरागत): According to the customs or usual practices associated with a particular society, place, or set of circumstances.
    
        **Example:** It is customary in some cultures to greet guests with a cup of tea.
    

    **Routine** (दिनचर्या): A sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.
    
        **Example:** Exercising every morning is a part of his daily routine.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence where the homonym "seal" means a sea animal.

options.text: He put his official seal on the agreement.
The lawyer broke the wax seal on the letter.
We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.**

**Key Points**

    The word **"seal"** has multiple meanings, making it a homonym (a word that is spelled and pronounced the same but has different meanings). 
        
            **Meaning 1:** A sea animal that lives in water and on land, known for its playful nature. (समुद्री जीव)
            **Example:** We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.
        
    
    **Meaning 2:** A stamp or device used to close something or show authentication. (महर या सील)
        
            **Example:** He put his official seal on the agreement.
        
    
    The correct word "seal" in this context refers to the sea animal, as described in Option 3. (समुद्री जीव)
        
            **Example:** Seals are often seen performing tricks in aquariums.
        
    

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. We saw a seal clapping its fins at the zoo.**

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

    **Option 1: He put his official seal on the agreement.** (उसने समझौते पर अपनी आधिकारिक मुहर लगाई।)
        
            **Explanation:** Here, "seal" refers to a stamp or mark used for authentication. This does not refer to the sea animal.
            **Example:** The document was stamped with an official seal.
        
    
    **Option 2: The lawyer broke the wax seal on the letter.** (वकील ने पत्र पर लगी मोम की मुहर तोड़ी।)
        
            **Explanation:** In this case, "seal" refers to the wax used to close the letter. It is not related to the sea animal.
            **Example:** The wax seal was carefully removed to read the letter.
        
    
    **Option 4: Please seal the envelope properly.** (कृपया लिफाफे को सही से बंद करें।)
        
            **Explanation:** Here, "seal" means to close something securely. This is also not related to the sea animal.
            **Example:** Make sure to seal the package before shipping it.

questions.questionText:

The art of preserving an animal's body by stuffing or mounting.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Shakespeare wrote many plays.

options.text: Many plays were written by Shakespeare.
Many plays was written by Shakespeare.
Many plays have be written by Shakespeare.
Many plays has been written by Shakespeare.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Key Points**

	Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
	In the active voice, the sentence is: "Shakespeare wrote many plays."
	To convert to passive voice: Place the object "many plays" at the beginning of the sentence.
	Change the active verb form "wrote" (simple past) to "were written" (simple past passive).
	Since "plays" is plural, the plural auxiliary verb "were" must be used instead of "was."
	Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Shakespeare."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Many plays were written by Shakespeare."*

 

**Additional Information**

	**Option 2: **"Many plays was written by Shakespeare." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement; "plays" requires "were."
	**Option 3: **"Many plays have be written by Shakespeare." – Grammatically incorrect verb construction.
	**Option 4: **"Many plays has been written by Shakespeare." – Incorrect tense (present perfect) and subject-verb agreement.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Do greenhouse gases cause global warming?

options.text: Is global warming caused by greenhouse gases?
Are global warming caused by greenhouse gases?
Does global warming caused by greenhouse gases?
Do global warming caused by greenhouse gases?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Key Points**

	Passive voice structure for interrogative sentences (Simple Present): **Is/Am/Are + Subject + Past Participle (V3) + by + Agent?**
	In the active voice, the sentence is: "Do greenhouse gases cause global warming?" (Simple Present).
	To convert to passive voice: The object "global warming" becomes the new subject.
	Since "global warming" is singular, the auxiliary verb "Is" is used at the beginning.
	The main verb "cause" changes to its past participle form, "caused."
	The original subject "greenhouse gases" becomes the agent following the preposition "by."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Is global warming caused by greenhouse gases?"*

 

**Additional Information**

	**Option 2: **"Are global warming caused by greenhouse gases?" – Incorrect subject-verb agreement; "global warming" is singular and requires "Is."
	**Option 3: **"Does global warming caused by greenhouse gases?" – "Does" is used in active voice; passive voice requires a form of the verb "to be."
	**Option 4: **"Do global warming caused by greenhouse gases?" – Incorrect auxiliary verb and incorrect subject-verb agreement.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Will the project have been completed by the research team before the deadline?

options.text: Has the research team completed the project before the deadline?
Is the research team completing the project before the deadline?
Will the research team complete the project before the deadline?
Will the research team have completed the project before the deadline?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Key Points**

	The given sentence is in the **Passive Voice** of the **Future Perfect Tense** in an interrogative form.
	Passive voice structure for Future Perfect (Interrogative): **Will + Object + have been + Past Participle (V3) + by + Subject?**
	To convert it into the **Active Voice**, the structure should be: **Will + Subject + have + Past Participle (V3) + Object?**
	The subject in the passive sentence "the research team" becomes the subject of the active sentence.
	The object "the project" becomes the object of the active sentence.
	The verb phrase "have been completed" changes to "have completed" in the active voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Will the research team have completed the project before the deadline?"*

 

**Additional Information**

	**Option 1: **"Has the research team completed..." – Incorrect because it uses the **Present Perfect** tense.
	**Option 2: **"Is the research team completing..." – Incorrect because it uses the **Present Continuous** tense.
	**Option 3: **"Will the research team complete..." – Incorrect because it uses the **Future Simple** tense instead of the Future Perfect.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Why aren't benign tumours rejected by the body?

options.text: Why don't the body reject benign tumours?
Why won't the body reject benign tumours?
Why doesn't the body reject benign tumours?
Why can't the body reject benign tumours?

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Key Points**

	The given sentence is in the **Passive Voice** of the **Simple Present Tense** in an interrogative (negative) form.
	Passive voice structure for Simple Present (Interrogative Negative): **Wh-word + am/is/are + not + Object + Past Participle (V3) + by + Agent?**
	To convert it into the **Active Voice**, the structure should be: **Wh-word + do/does + not + Subject + Base Verb (V1) + Object?**
	The agent in the passive sentence "the body" becomes the subject of the active sentence.
	Since "the body" is a **singular** third-person subject, the auxiliary verb **"does"** (specifically "doesn't") must be used.
	The verb "rejected" (V3) changes back to its base form "reject" (V1).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why doesn't the body reject benign tumours?"*

 

**Additional Information**

	**Option 1: **"Why don't the body..." – Incorrect because "the body" is singular and requires "doesn't" rather than "don't."
	**Option 2: **"Why won't the body..." – Incorrect because it changes the tense from Simple Present to **Simple Future**.
	**Option 4: **"Why can't the body..." – Incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence to **ability/possibility** (Modal verb).

questions.questionText:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

Between the advantages of being an Indian citizen, freedom to worship one's own god is of utmost importance for the orthodox.

options.text: freedom to worship one's own god is
of utmost importance for the orthodox.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Key Points**

	The error lies in the use of the preposition "**Between**" in part A of the sentence.
	The preposition "**Between**" is generally used when referring to two distinct people, places, or things.
	The preposition "**Among**" is used when referring to more than two things or when talking about a collective group (like "the advantages").
	Since the sentence discusses one advantage out of a larger set of advantages of being a citizen, "**Among**" is the grammatically correct choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Among** the advantages of being an Indian citizen, freedom to worship one's own god is of utmost importance for the orthodox."*

 

**Additional Information**

	**Option 2: "being an Indian citizen,"** – This part is grammatically correct as it functions as the object of the prepositional phrase.
	**Option 3: "freedom to worship one's own god is"** – This part is correctly structured; "freedom" is the singular subject, and "is" is the singular verb.
	**Option 4: "of utmost importance for the orthodox."** – This part correctly conveys the degree of importance for a specific group of people.

questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

This song is not befitting _______ the Independence Day Celebration.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 

**Key Points**

    The preposition **"for"** is used to indicate the purpose or suitability of something.
    In this sentence, the phrase "befitting for" is correct as it conveys the idea of appropriateness for the Independence Day Celebration.
    **Other options:**
        
            **"to"**: Incorrect, as it does not fit the context of appropriateness or purpose.
            **"on"**: Incorrect, as it refers to a specific time or date rather than suitability.
            **"by"**: Incorrect, as it refers to agency or means, not suitability.
        
    

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"This song is not befitting **for** the Independence Day Celebration."*

 

**Additional Information**

    **Usage of "for":** This preposition is commonly used to indicate the purpose, suitability, or intended recipient of something.
    **Example:** "This dress is perfect for the party."
    **Common Prepositional Errors:**
        
            **"To":** Often confused with "for," but it indicates direction, not purpose.
            **"On":** Refers to specific dates, surfaces, or positions, not suitability.

questions.questionText:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. So why develop your financial genius?
A. I can tell you why I have been developing this area of my intelligence.
B. Not because I need to, but because I want to.
C. Only you can answer that.
D. I do it because I want to make money fast.
S2. It is a fascinating learning process.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Key Points**

    The question asks for the logical arrangement of sentences in a paragraph to maintain unity and coherence.
    **Sentence S1** is the opening sentence that introduces the topic: ""So why develop your financial genius?""
    **Sentence C** is the first in the sequence after S1 as it directly addresses the question and places responsibility on the individual: ""Only you can answer that.""
    **Sentence A** follows as it provides a personal perspective from the author: ""I can tell you why I have been developing this area of my intelligence.""
    **Sentence D** comes next as it explains the author's motivation for developing financial intelligence: ""I do it because I want to make money fast.""
    **Sentence B** is the final sentence before S2 as it emphasizes the author's personal choice: ""Not because I need to, but because I want to.""
    The paragraph ends with **Sentence S2**: ""It is a fascinating learning process.""
    The correct sequence is **CADB**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

""So why develop your financial genius? Only you can answer that. I can tell you why I have been developing this area of my intelligence. I do it because I want to make money fast. Not because I need to, but because I want to. It is a fascinating learning process.""

The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Key Points**

 
    This question involves rearranging the jumbled sentences to form a coherent paragraph. 
    **Sentence B is the first sentence** following S1: 
         
            "She was left alone, quite alone, as she had always wished to be left." 
            This sentence logically follows S1 as it continues the idea of Sofia being left alone after her mother and sister departed. 
         
     
    **Sentence A follows** because it delves into Sofia’s childhood experiences and habits: 
         
            "As a child, when some wrong or injustice had been done her, she had cried all alone, when she was in bed, in the dark, and the habit had remained with her." 
            This sentence explains her emotional state and further develops her character. 
         
     
    **Sentence D is the third sentence** because it describes her current emotional state in detail: 
         
            "Now, alone in the great drawing room, beneath the brightly lighted chandelier, her hands inert, her head resting against the back of her chair, her face wore an expression of great sorrow, the vivid reflection of a serious inward conflict." 
            This sentence connects her past emotions with her present solitude and sorrow. 
         
     
    **Sentence C is the fourth** as it brings in the realization of her grief and solitude: 
         
            "Certainly in these moments of complete solitude the consciousness of a great grief came over her." 
            This sentence ties the narrative together and leads smoothly into S2. 
         
     
    The correct sequence is **BADC**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Sofia stood listening to the noise of the departing carriage which bore away her mother and sister. She was left alone, quite alone, as she had always wished to be left. As a child, when some wrong or injustice had been done her, she had cried all alone, when she was in bed, in the dark, and the habit had remained with her. Now, alone in the great drawing room, beneath the brightly lighted chandelier, her hands inert, her head resting against the back of her chair, her face wore an expression of great sorrow, the vivid reflection of a serious inward conflict. Certainly in these moments of complete solitude the consciousness of a great grief came over her; the sentiment of the reality, long repulsed, became clear, distinct, and cruel."

questions.questionText:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

If I would be laid off again, I would seriously consider a career switch.

options.text: were to be laid off again

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**3**'.

 

**Key Points**

    The given sentence is an example of the **second conditional**, which is used to describe hypothetical or unlikely situations.
    In a second conditional sentence, the correct structure is **If + past simple, would + base verb**.
    The underlined phrase "**If I would be laid off again**" is incorrect because "**would**" is not used in the "**if**" clause.
    Option 3, "**were to be laid off again**," correctly uses the "**were to + base verb**" structure, which is appropriate for hypothetical situations.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"If I were to be laid off again, I would seriously consider a career switch."*

 

**Additional Information**

    **Option 1:** "will be laid off again" is incorrect because the first conditional uses "**if + present simple, will + base verb**." However, this sentence describes a hypothetical situation, not a real possibility.
    **Option 2:** "had been laid off again" is incorrect because it suggests a past unreal situation, which would require a third conditional structure: "**if + past perfect, would have + past participle**."
    **Option 4:** "No improvement required" is incorrect because the underlined part does not follow the correct grammatical structure for the second conditional.

questions.questionText:
Choose the correct verb form to complete the sentence.

"Startups ______ a cultural shift from job seekers to job creators by fostering entrepreneurial opportunities nationwide."
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

**Key Points**

	***Option 2: drive***

	
		The subject of the sentence is **"Startups"**, which is a **plural noun**.
		According to the rules of **subject-verb agreement**, a plural subject requires a plural verb (the base form of the verb without an 's').
		Since the sentence describes a general fact or ongoing state in the present tense, **"drive"** is the correct form to match the plural subject.
	
	
	***Option 1: drives***
	
		This is **incorrect** because "drives" is the third-person singular form. It would be correct if the subject were singular (e.g., "The **startup drives** change").
	
	
	***Option 3: driving***
	
		This is **incorrect**. A present participle (ending in -ing) cannot function as the main verb of a sentence on its own; it requires an auxiliary verb like "are" (e.g., "Startups **are driving** a shift").
	
	
	***Option 4: driven***
	
		This is **incorrect**. "Driven" is a past participle and needs a helping verb to form a complete thought (e.g., "Startups **have driven** a shift" or "A shift **is driven** by startups").
	
	

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Additional Information**

	**Subject-Verb Agreement Rule**: In the present tense, most verbs only change their ending for the third-person singular (he/she/it). For plural subjects (they), the verb remains in its base form.
	**Vocabulary Note**: In this context, to **"drive"** a shift means to be the primary cause or force behind a significant change in behavior or mindset within a society.
	**Unicorns**: As mentioned in the passage, a "unicorn" in the business world refers to a privately held startup company valued at over $1 billion.

questions.questionText:
Choose the correct verb form to complete the sentence from the passage.

"This ecosystem ______ produced over a hundred unicorns, startups valued at over one billion dollars."
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

**Key Points**

	***Option 1: has***

	
		The subject of the sentence is **"This ecosystem"**.
		The word "ecosystem" is a **singular noun**. In English grammar, a third-person singular subject requires the auxiliary verb **"has"** to form the **Present Perfect Tense**.
		The Present Perfect Tense (**has + past participle**) is used here to describe an action that started in the past and has a result in the present (producing over a hundred unicorns).
	
	
	***Option 2: have***
	
		This is **incorrect**. "Have" is used for plural subjects (e.g., "These **ecosystems have**...") or with the pronouns I, you, we, and they.
	
	
	***Option 3: had***
	
		This is **incorrect** in this context. "Had" is the **Past Perfect** auxiliary. The passage is written in the present tense to describe the current state of India's startup growth. "Had" would suggest the action was completed and finished before another past event.
	
	
	***Option 4: having***
	
		This is **incorrect**. "Having" is a present participle and cannot function as the main auxiliary verb to support the past participle "produced" in this sentence structure.
	
	

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Additional Information**

	**Subject-Verb Agreement**: Always identify the head noun of the subject phrase. Here, the head noun is "ecosystem," not "startups" or "unicorns" which appear later in the sentence.
	**Unicorns in Business**: The passage defines a "unicorn" as a startup valued at over **$1 billion**. This is a common term used in the venture capital industry.
	**Flagship Initiative**: The phrase "flagship initiative" refers to the most important or leading program of an organization—in this case, the **Startup India** program launched by the government.

questions.questionText: What does the word “synergy” mean as used in the passage?

options.text: Cooperation that leads to a greater effect

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. cooperation that leads to a greater effect.

**Key Points**

	The word **"synergy"** means:

	
		The interaction or cooperation of two or more organizations, substances, or other agents to produce a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects. (सहयोग जिससे अधिक प्रभाव होता है)
	
	
	The correct meaning of "synergy" in the given context is **"cooperation that leads to a greater effect."**
	**Example from the passage:** The synergy between the two departments resulted in an innovative product.
	
		**Example:** By working together, the teams created a synergy that greatly enhanced their productivity.
	
	

Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of “synergy” is: **cooperation that leads to a greater effect.**

**Additional Information**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

	**Conflict** (संघर्ष): A serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

	
		**Example:** There was a conflict of interest between the two parties.
	
	
	**Separation** (अलगाव): The action or state of moving or being moved apart.
	
		**Example:** The separation of the two companies was finalized last year.
	
	
	**Competition** (प्रतिस्पर्धा): The activity or condition of competing.
	
		**Example:** There is fierce competition in the tech industry.

questions.questionText: The word “flourishing” in the passage most nearly means ___________.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

**Key Points**

	***Option 4: thriving and growing***

	
		In the context of the passage, **"flourishing"** is used to describe sectors like fintech, edtech, and e-commerce that are experiencing **"remarkable growth"** and **"gaining global recognition."**
		The word derives from the Latin *florere* (to bloom), and in a business or economic context, it refers to an entity that is prospering, expanding, and reaching a state of high success.
		The surrounding text mentions that these sectors are **"addressing local challenges"** and contributing to the production of **"unicorns,"** which reinforces the idea of vigorous health and expansion.
	
	
	***Option 1: declining***
	
		This is **incorrect**. "Declining" is an antonym (opposite) of flourishing. The passage describes a surge in growth, not a decrease.
	
	
	***Option 2: ignoring***
	
		This is **incorrect**. "Ignoring" refers to a lack of attention and does not fit the description of an active, growing economic sector.
	
	
	***Option 3: struggling***
	
		This is **incorrect**. While startups may face challenges, the passage uses "flourishing" to highlight the **success** and **powerhouse** status of the ecosystem, which is the opposite of struggling.
	
	

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 

**Additional Information**

	**Synonyms**: Prospering, burgeoning, blooming, successful, robust.
	**Antonyms**: Withering, fading, failing, stagnant, declining.
	**Usage in Business**: When an "ecosystem" or "sector" is flourishing, it means the environment is conducive to success, leading to high investment, innovation, and job creation.
	**Context Clue**: The use of the word **"surge"** earlier in the passage acts as a context clue, suggesting upward momentum and rapid development.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best summarizes the main idea of the passage?

options.text: India’s startup growth is mostly centered in a few large cities with little government support.
The startup ecosystem in India is shrinking due to lack of innovation.
India’s startup ecosystem is expanding rapidly due to government initiatives, technology adoption, and widespread collaboration, contributing significantly to economic and employment growth.
Startups in India only focus on local markets without global ambitions.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

**Key Points**

	***Option 3: India’s startup ecosystem is expanding rapidly due to government initiatives, technology adoption, and widespread collaboration, contributing significantly to economic and employment growth.***

	
		The passage emphasizes **"remarkable growth"** and India's status as the **"third-largest startup hub globally."**
		It specifically credits the **"Startup India" initiative** for providing financial and regulatory support, matching the "government initiatives" part of the summary.
		It mentions **"tech-savvy professionals"** and **"internet penetration"** (technology adoption) and the **"synergy among incubators, accelerators, investors, and the government"** (widespread collaboration).
		Finally, it notes the **"economic growth and employment generation"** caused by over a hundred unicorns and the shift to becoming "job creators."
	
	
	***Option 1: ...mostly centered in a few large cities with little government support.***
	
		This is **incorrect**. The text states the government's role is **"pivotal"** and that tier-2 and tier-3 cities are **"increasingly contributing."**
	
	
	***Option 2: The startup ecosystem in India is shrinking...***
	
		This is **incorrect**. The entire passage focuses on **growth, flourishing sectors, and expansion.**
	
	
	***Option 4: ...only focus on local markets without global ambitions.***
	
		This is **incorrect**. The passage mentions startups are **"gaining global recognition"** and fueled by the ambition to become a **"global startup powerhouse."**
	
	

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Additional Information**

	**Unicorns**: As defined in the passage, these are startups valued at over **$1 billion**. India having over a hundred of them signals a very mature and high-value ecosystem.
	**Cultural Shift**: The passage highlights a transition from a **"job seeker"** mentality to a **"job creator"** mentality, which is vital for long-term economic sustainability.
	**Sector Success**: The "flourishing" status of **fintech, edtech, and healthtech** shows that Indian innovation is heavily focused on using technology to solve practical problems in finance, education, and healthcare.
